summary: A host firmware that keeps several synths as modules in flash, so you can switch between them from a picker on HOME without reinstalling.
features: Comes with CS-1, Scintilla, OberVave and a sine
Add modules like FM-106, DUB-1 or FM-1 SID from a web page
Shared options: MIDI channel filter, local off, master EQ, MIDI thru
Optional Bluetooth MIDI; uses the FM-1's second core
SDK and tools for building and deploying your own module over USB
Flash for added modules is limited; large modules crowd out others
